verified: a stalled-changing or expanding reason creates one stable semantic boundary; attempt, progress-key, minor diff, verification, and irrelevant queue churn do not re-invoke the authority
convergence is relative to the immediately preceding failure set, so an early reduction followed by a persistent residual failure is stalled-changing rather than converging forever
a genuinely new reason such as a newly higher-priority P0 Safety frontier creates the next boundary across source-run lineage
a controller-checkpointed worktree ends with first-class yielded step and run statuses, yields behind P0 Safety, and resumes the same task, claim, worktree, diff, checkpoint, and evidence lineage
an explicit Not verified criterion is reported as addressed but unresolved rather than counted as verified
a checkpoint failure through the production controller retains the original active claim and dirty diff, fails the run, and never reports priority-yield
resumption reuses the checkpoint instead of creating a duplicate checkpoint commit
yielded repair lineage is excluded from terminal failure rates and repair-failure tallies until its resumed lineage reaches a terminal outcome
decomposition reuses reviewer-confirmed semantically equivalent open tasks, retains parent and intra-plan dependencies, preserves reused acceptance evidence, and does not create a duplicate task
